features: 【Farmhouse Design Bathroom Countertop Organizer】Thanks to its wooden material and unique beaded design, the bathroom counter tray has a unique rustic aesthetic, which spice up your bath decor and impress your guests.. Meanwhile, with the practical handle, you can easily move the organizer to anywhere you want without removing any items on it.

【LARGE CAPACITY & SPACE SAVING】The top shelf of this bathroom organizer measures 14.9x5.7in, and the bottom layer measures 14.9x7.2in. The height between two layers is 7.3in, suitable for most of cosmetic bottles. The double layers’ space is enough for your daily storage needs, let your countertop far away from clutter.

【STURDY & ROBUST】Our bathroom bathroom storage is made of high quality solid wood with stable metal structure. Each wooden tray can hold up to 5kg and the metal bracket is rust-resistant for long-term use. The bottom legs make the bathroom organizer stay away from water stains, you can use the countertop organizer safely in the wet bathroom.

【Multi-Functional Organizer Shelf】Our 2-tier organizer rack can be used in living room, bathroom, office, desk, also can using as small plant stand, vanity tray, makeup organizer rack, bathroom sink organizer, kitchen snack organizer and countertop coffee station organizer. It can also used as perfume cosmetic organizers and storage.etc.

【Perfect Gift Idea】This versatile bathroom counter organizer is a practical gift for your family or friends as Housewarming, Birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas gifts. We guarantee 100% Customer Satisfaction, Please feel free to contact us in case of any order-related issues.
